faqs.q: Is Richmond too competitive to bother with SEO?
faqs.a: Not if you are specific. Richmond is large enough that most of its searches are narrow, and those narrow searches are the ones a focused veterinarian can realistically own.

faqs.q: Should I try to target all of Richmond at once?
faqs.a: Usually not. A profile set to the entire city dilutes relevance. It is more effective to serve your real catchment first, then extend into neighbouring areas with pages of their own.

faqs.q: Does British Columbia regulation affect my Richmond page?
faqs.a: It can. Rules about titles and advertising vary by profession and province, so your content should use only the claims and credentials you are entitled to make in British Columbia.

faqs.q: What should a Richmond page include?
faqs.a: A clear description of your service, the areas you cover, how to book a appointment, what it costs, and the proof pet owners look for before they make contact.
